question: 2025年第四季度中，销量最高的3个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与销量）
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sold DESC, c.name LIMIT 3
